title: HubSpot private app access token placeholders, references, masks and bare Bearer scheme
summary: The documented Bearer [YOUR_TOKEN] form, a bare scheme, a tokenKey member holding a placeholder, an environment reference and a masked display, and prose that names the member.
rationale: HubSpot writes the header as Bearer [YOUR_TOKEN] (claim private-app-token-exists), a documented placeholder; a bare scheme, a reference or a mask carries no value. The masked asterisk placeholder HubSpot shows is attached to the static auth access token, a separate family, and is not reused as a private app layout. Flagging these forms would redact documentation a reader needs.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, redact-secret#1228 Group C). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: the values here are the documented placeholder, a bare scheme, references, masks or prose, not credential values; that such forms are not values is a project decision. HubSpot documents the Bearer [YOUR_TOKEN] form (carrier existence only).

sources.supports: When making a call to one of the HubSpot API endpoints, set the value of the Authorization field to Bearer [YOUR_TOKEN].
